caption:
Cost per lead can climb 20% in a month.

Check your ads once every few weeks and you'd never catch it. By the time the jump is obvious, you've already overpaid on dozens of leads.

The fix: run the math weekly, not occasionally.

1. Monday morning: pull last week's ad spend and lead count.
2. Drop both into the Ad ROI Calculator.
3. Compare the result to the number from two weeks back.

A swing past 15-20% week over week usually means something changed. Creative fatigue. Audience overlap. A bid shift.

Catch it there and fix it before it costs you a month's margin.
